description: The prioritised to-do list across ALL of the user's domains in a single call: critical and high-severity issues, open quests, the next unfinished growth-plan step, projects with a missing or stale scan, and missing integrations. Start here when the user asks what to improve, what to do next, or to 'optimise the site' without naming a specific domain — it saves querying every project separately. Each entry names the domain, an id or key to work with, and which tool to call next.
